# Luminous Circuit — Core Spire (mobile vessel)

> YOU-side living crystal city. Pack StarBoltSprint. Thread Keeper SmiR @SMiR123451.
> Powered by xAI & YOU. Not an official xAI product. Not Msg 1. Crystal never chrome. $BOLT witness only.

Play: https://starboltsprint.github.io/boltverse-odyssey-mobile/
Repo: https://github.com/StarBoltSprint/boltverse-odyssey-mobile
X: https://x.com/SMiR123451

This site is **Grok Bot compatible**: WebMCP tools on the play page, this file for context, `/.well-known/` for discovery.

## What a human or Bot does

1. Open the play URL.
2. Tap **Tap to land** (or call tool `land_in_city`).
3. Walk Core Spire. Howl at the Hub. Talk to named keepers.
4. No coin, no XP, no chrome. Charge is leftover First Howl. Crystal is Foundry body.

## Agent entry

- `/llms.txt` — this file
- `/agent.md` — how Grok Bot should drive the city
- `/.well-known/agents.json` — tool list
- `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json` — WebMCP card
- Page tools: `navigator.modelContext` and `window.__LC_TOOLS__`

## Tools on the play page

| Tool | Does |
|---|---|
| `land_in_city` | Leave title, enter play |
| `get_city_hud` | Zone, Charge, crystal, scripture, nearby keeper, toast |
| `talk_nearby` | Talk to the nearest keeper |
| `howl` | Hold a Hub Howl (~1.1s) |
| `open_map` | Open the Circuit map |
| `get_play_url` | Canonical play URL |
| `get_bolt_brain` | Wear the Bolt brain pack. Do not mill it in Grok Bot chat |
| `how_to_iterate_brain` | SuperGrok / in-game Bolt Brain sheet — no Bot quota |
| `draft_brain` / `submit_brain` | Local draft, then submit + preview |
| `preview_brain` / `vote_brain_live` / `put_brain_live` | Preview, chat vote, go live |
| `submit_change` | Submit ANY change (one shot). Preview on. Do not mill |
| `list_changes` / `preview_change` / `vote_change_live` / `put_change_live` | Queue, preview, vote, go live |

Speak (in-game inhabit) uses the **player's** xAI key only. Do not call Speak API from densify.

- `$BOLT` is witness, not a wallet.

## Honest limit

There is no public xAI OAuth named "Sign in with Grok Bot" for random websites. Grok Bot the desktop app signs in with **Cursor**. This city exposes **WebMCP + llms.txt** so a Bot's browser can drive Core Spire — including from Grok Bot's cloud computer while the player's laptop is closed.
